title: sci-RNA-seq3 Protocol for Nuclei Isolation and Analysis
author: Junyue Cao, Jay Shendure
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9yih7ue
materials: Cell lysis buffer(CLB) (Made fresh each time, 5ml per sample, stored on ice): Nuclei buffer with 0.1% IGEPAL CA-630, 1% SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor (20 U/µL, Ambion) and 1% BSA (20 mg/ml, NEB). For each sample, combine 4.85ml nuclei buffer, 50ul 10% (volume) IGEPAL CA-630, 50ul SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor (20 U/µL, Ambion), and 50ul BSA (20 mg/ml, NEB).

Nuclei suspension buffer (NSB) (Made fresh each time, 3ml per sample, stored on ice): Nuclei buffer with 1% SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor (20 U/µL, Ambion) and 1% BSA (20 mg/ml, NEB). For each sample, combine 4.9ml nuclei buffer, 50ul SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor (20 U/µL, Ambion), and 50ul BSA (20 mg/ml, NEB).

Preparation before the experiment: Cool the centrifuge to 4C. Prepare nuclei suspension buffer (NSB): for 25 samples, combine 40ml nuclei buffer, 400ul SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor (20 U/µL, Ambion), and 400ul BSA (20 mg/ml, NEB). Store the mixture on ice. Prepare nuclei buffer with 1% BSA (NBB): 100ml nuclei buffer and 1ml BSA (20 mg/ml, NEB). Store the buffer on ice.
Count the nuclei concentration with a hemacytometer.
Library concentrations were determined by Qubit (Invitrogen) and the libraries were visualized by electrophoresis on a 6% TBE-PAGE gel (example image shown below).

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 500ml Nuclei buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl2 in nuclease-free water).

substeps.instruction: Filter the buffer through a 0.22uM filter.
Store at 4°C for up to 1 year.

steps.title: Prepare 10% IGEPAL CA-630 Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 20ml of 10% (volume) IGEPAL CA-630 in nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Add 2ml IGEPAL CA-630 to 18ml nuclease-free water.
Mix by pipetting up and down 20 times.
Store at 4°C for up to 1 year.

steps.title: Prepare 10% Triton X-100 Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 20ml of 10% (volume) Triton X-100 in nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Add 2ml Triton X-100 to 18ml nuclease-free water.
Mix by pipetting up and down 20 times.
Store at 4°C for up to 1 year.

steps.title: Tissue Dissociation and Nuclei Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract nuclei from frozen tissue (0.1g-0.5g, frozen in liquid nitrogen or -80°C) using cold lysis buffer (CLB).

substeps.instruction: Cool the centrifuge to 4°C.
Add 1ml CLB to the frozen tissue in a 6cm dish.
Cut tissue into pieces < 1mm in diameter using a blade or surgical scalpel; alternatively, mash frozen tissue into powder with a hammer on dry ice before sampling.
Pipet the tissue up and down 10 times using a 1ml pipet tip (with the top cut off) and transfer to a 15ml tube containing another 3ml CLB.
Transfer the CLB and tissue to a 40um cell strainer (placed in a 6-well plate on ice) and homogenize using the rubber tip of a syringe plunger, ensuring tissue remains submerged in cold lysis buffer.

steps.title: Nuclei Washing and Fixation
steps.instruction: Isolate, wash, and fix the extracted nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Transfer filtered nuclei to a new 15ml tube, pellet at 500g for 5min, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 1ml CLB by pipetting up and down 3 times.
Pellet nuclei at 500g for 5min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 100ul NSB, add 10ml ice-cold 4% PFA, and invert tubes 5 times.
Fix nuclei on ice for 15min.
Pellet nuclei at 500g for 3min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 1ml NSB, transfer to a new tube, pellet at 500g for 5min, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 1ml NSB, pellet at 500g for 5min, and remove as much supernatant as possible via pipetting.
Resuspend nuclei in 500ul NSB.
Split nuclei into five tubes (100ul each).
Flash freeze in liquid nitrogen and store in liquid nitrogen or -80°C freezer.

steps.title: Nuclei Permeabilization and Sonication
steps.instruction: Thaw and permeabilize nuclei followed by sonication.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 100ul flash-frozen PFA-fixed nuclei in a 37°C water bath.
Pellet nuclei at 500g for 5min (4°C) and remove supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 100ul NSB.
Add a mixture containing 390ul NSB and 10ul 10% Triton X-100 to each sample.
Incubate on ice for 3min.
Pellet nuclei at 500g for 5min (4°C), remove supernatant, and resuspend in 400ul NSB.
Perform sonication using a Bioruptor device (low power mode, 12s).
Filter nuclei through a Flowmi cell strainer.
Pellet nuclei at 500g for 5min (4°C) and remove supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 100ul NSB and determine concentration using a hemocytometer.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription on the isolated nuclei.

substeps.instruction: For each well of 4 x 96-well plates, add 80,000 nuclei in 22ul nuclei buffer (using wide bore tips), 2ul 10mM dNTP, and 2ul indexed oligo-dT primer (100uM).
Incubate plates at 55°C for 5min, then immediately place on ice.

Prepare RT reaction mix: combine 3280ul 5X Superscript IV First-Strand Buffer, 820ul 100mM DTT, 820ul SuperScript IV reverse transcriptase, and 820ul RNaseOUT Recombinant Ribonuclease Inhibitor. Mix well and distribute 14ul per well.
Run RT program: 4°C (2min), 10°C (2min), 20°C (2min), 30°C (2min), 40°C (2min), 50°C (2min), and 55°C (15min).

steps.title: Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform ligation of indexed oligos to the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 60ul ice-cold NBB to each well using a multichannel pipette.
Pellet nuclei at 500g for 10min and remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 4.3ml NSB and distribute 10ul into each well of 4 x 96-well plates.
Add 8ul indexed ligation oligos (100uM) to each well using a multichannel pipette.
Prepare ligation master mix: combine 8.6ml Quick ligase buffer and 860ul Quick ligase. Mix well and distribute 22ul into each well, pipetting up and down 5 times with a wide bore tip.

steps.title: Nuclei Purification and Distribution
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei and distribute them into plates for second strand synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Add 60ul NBB to each well and pool nuclei from all wells using wide bore tips.
Add another 40ml NBB to the mix, pellet at 600g for 10min, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 5ml NBB, pellet at 600g for 10min, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 4ml NBB and filter through a Flowmi cell strainer (repeat if doublets are visible under microscope).
Distribute diluted nuclei in NBB into 96-well plates at 2500 to 4000 nuclei per well (5ul total volume).
Briefly spin plates. Store at -80°C for up to 1 month if needed.

steps.title: Second Strand Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize the second strand of DNA.

substeps.instruction: Thaw one plate at room temperature.

Prepare second strand synthesis mix: combine 330ul elution buffer, 146.7ul second strand synthesis buffer, and 73.3ul second strand synthesis enzyme. Mix well and distribute 5ul per well; briefly centrifuge.
Incubate at 16°C for 3 hours.
Prepare tagmentation mix: combine 1.1ml tagmentation buffer and 2.75ul N7 adaptor loaded Tn5. Mix well.
Briefly centrifuge the plate and add 10ul reaction mix to each well.
Incubate at 55°C for 5min.

steps.title: USER Enzyme Treatment and Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Process DNA with USER enzyme and perform Ampure XP bead purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 20ul DNA binding buffer per well and incubate at room temperature for 5min.
Prepare USER mix: combine 880ul nuclease-free water, 110ul 10X USER buffer, and 110ul USER enzyme (NEB). Mix well.
Add 40ul Ampure XP beads to each well, mix well, incubate at room temperature for 5min, and briefly centrifuge.
Place plate on magnetic stand for 5min and remove supernatant.
Wash each well twice with 100ul 80% ethanol.
Carefully remove all supernatant and dry the plate at room temperature for 3min.
Add 10ul USER reaction mix to each well, seal, vortex, briefly centrifuge, and incubate at 37°C for 15min.
Briefly centrifuge, add 7ul elution buffer to each well, and mix well.
Briefly centrifuge and leave on magnetic stand for 3min.
Transfer 16ul of supernatant to a new 96-well plate on ice.

steps.title: PCR Amplification and Final Purification
steps.instruction: Amplify the library via PCR and perform final bead cleanups.

substeps.instruction: To each well, add 2ul P5 PCR primer (10uM), 2ul P7 primer (10uM), and 20ul NEBnext master mix.
Run PCR program: 72°C for 5min; 98°C for 30sec; 12-15 cycles of (98°C for 10sec, 66°C for 30sec, 72°C for 30sec); final 72°C for 5min.
Pool all wells together and take 1ml PCR product for 0.7X Ampure XP beads purification. Elute in 100ul elution buffer.
Perform a second round of 0.8x Ampure XP beads purification.
